info.title: F-Grade Zoho CRM API
info.description: Single read-only CRM query endpoint optimized for Microsoft Copilot Studio. Use GET /api/crm/query with query parameters to fetch records from Zoho CRM modules.

servers.description: Public ngrok URL for Copilot Studio integration

get.description: Read-only query endpoint. Use the 'module' query parameter to select which Zoho CRM module to query (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Events). Supports retrieval_mode selection, pagination when needed, field selection, filter criteria, and explicit ids. This endpoint does not create, update, or delete records.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Canonical or natural-language module name. Examples: Leads, Lead, Contacts, Contact, Deals, Deal, Events, Meeting. Matching is case-insensitive and trimmed. Aliases are resolved by the backend.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional page number for paginated requests only. Not required for retrieval_mode=count or retrieval_mode=all.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Optional records-per-page value for paginated requests only. Not required for retrieval_mode=count or retrieval_mode=all. Maximum depends on Zoho CRM limits.

parameters.name: retrieval_mode
parameters.description: Controls CRM record retrieval. Use 'count' whenever the user's request asks for how many, total, count, or similar filtered count answers and only the record count is needed. Use 'all' whenever the user's request requires the complete matching dataset, including requests for all/every records, summaries, analytics, averages, rankings, comparisons, aggregations, complete filtered results, or calculations requiring all matching records. Use 'page' for ordinary list requests or explicitly requested pagination. Use 'auto' otherwise.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of field API names to include in each record. If omitted, a default field set is returned by the CRM service.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Zoho CRM criteria string for server-side filtering. Use Zoho's criteria syntax. If provided, this overrides basic 'search' style parameters.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of CRM record ids to fetch. When provided, pagination parameters may be ignored.

401.description: Authentication required or invalid OAuth token

500.description: Server error or Zoho API error
